notes: fcbayern.com (and the Forbes page) return HTTP 403 to scripted requests from this environment, so club pages and the 2024/25 accounts PDF are cited via their Wayback Machine copies of the official URLs (original PDF: https://fcbayern.com/binaries/content/assets/downloads/homepage/jhv/2025/jahresabschluss-24-25.pdf). Revenue (EUR 978.3m), EBITDA (EUR 187.8m) and pretax profit (EUR 42.5m) are GROUP figures for 1 Jul 2024-30 Jun 2025; group net profit after tax EUR 27.1m; group equity EUR 585.5m at 30.6.2025. The revenue breakdown and wages are from the FC Bayern München AG SINGLE-ENTITY accounts: matchday EUR 260.7m, media EUR 105.3m, 'commercial' here is sponsoring and marketing only (EUR 240.4m); merchandising (EUR 150.5m) and transfer income (EUR 117.7m) are separate lines not added in, 'other' is the 'Sonstiges' line (EUR 51.9m). Capacity: bundesliga.com gives 75,000 for league matches (the earlier record's 75,024 was not found on a citable page). The club page lists the e.V. at '75 %' (often described elsewhere as 75.01%). Years and prices of the adidas, Audi and Allianz stakes (all before 2015) were not found on a page I could read, so since_year/amount are null; no ownership, debt or stadium-financing transaction since 2015 was found. Chair is the e.V. president per a Nov 2025 snapshot. Bayern won the 2025/26 Bundesliga (club honours page), but no page read gives the total title count, so honours is null. Deloitte Money League figure from the earlier record (via goal.com) was dropped in favour of the club's own accounts.
ownership_summary: FC Bayern München AG, the club's football company, is 75% owned by the members' club FC Bayern München eV, with adidas AG, AUDI AG and Allianz SE holding 8.33% each as corporate minority shareholders; there is no private-equity or fund holder.
